description: Install an extension ORG-WIDE: creates the install link on EVERY company in your Final organization (demo companies included), skipping companies that already have it, so it is safe to retry. Installing is deliberate and org-visible — confirm with your user and call this ONLY when they explicitly asked for the extension. Find the id with list_extensions (organization and public extensions both install); after a successful install the extension's surfaces become embeddable — inspect them with list_extension_surfaces and build the ones carrying requirementsMd natively instead of embedding. Per-company failures are collected in the result rather than thrown, and `installState` reports the org-wide outcome (installed / partial / none).

extensionId.description: The extension's id (the `id` from a list_extensions result — org or public source).

hubToken.description: Organization JWT fallback, only if the hub rejects your API key for this route.

name: flow_install_extension
title: Install an extension org-wide
